text:
incident-bot: PAGED irene_oncall — spike: apac-cluster-1 5xx rate 11.8% over 5m, tail latency > 1.8s for gen endpoints. Affected model set: rdx-gpt-13b / rdx-embed-2. Rollback suggestion: steer traffic.

irene_oncall: Ack. I'm looking. @mike_sre are you able to triage infra (node pressure / GPU oom)?

mike_sre: joining. seeing elevated GPU mem pressure on pool-apac-1, a few long-running KV cache entries. no OOMs yet.

samira: adding context — we pushed a quantized model build earlier today; maybe batch/kv patterns changed.

apac-eng: we've got a backlog in the request queue, max inflight up ~30%. Perf regression coincides with a config tweak to economy-tier routing at 09:12 UTC.

irene_oncall: OK. Immediate mitigation ideas: 1) disable economy lane for apac region for rdx-gpt-13b, 2) steer eligible traffic to eu-west for non-low-latency customers, 3) apply short-term rate limit increase to dedicated pools to reduce queuing. Thoughts?

mike_sre: agree with 1 & 2. For 3 I prefer increasing soft concurrency for dedicated pools rather than global rate increase. will patch routing policy.

dana_prod: raising priority for customers on SLAs. we should message support with an impact blurb: "some users in APAC may see increased latencies and failures for generation endpoints; fallback to eu-west applied for non-low-latency plans."

ben_platform: prepping the smart-routing change now. plan: update policy `region_preference` weights, evict economy tier for apac for model set, add temporary hard cap for economy requests to 5rps per tenant (60s window).

irene_oncall: mike, run the policy update as a canary to 5% traffic first. paste command?

mike_sre: running CLI patch: ```redwoodctl routing update --policy smart-tiering --set "apac.pool.economy.enabled=false" --canary 0.05```

incident-bot: Deploy job 10824 started by mike_sre. CI checks passed.

apac-eng: applying steer: `region_fallback: eu-west:0.9, apac:0.1` for non-rt tiers.

mike_sre: canary applied. monitoring dashboards show initial drop in 5xx to 6% in canary shard. latency p50 unchanged, p95 trending down.

samira: rolling model-quantization revert isn't required if steering solves load but we should keep it as a follow-up.

dana_prod: Support note drafted: "We've applied routing changes to reduce errors in APAC — some non-SLA traffic now routes to EU. We're monitoring; contact support for continued issues."

irene_oncall: good. @ben_platform please hold off full rollout until we observe 15m stable. If stable, plan: ramp to 50% then full in 10m increments. Also prepare backout: `redwoodctl routing rollback --policy smart-tiering --to 10823`.

ben_platform: ack. preparing the rollback playbook and alert tags.

incident-bot: Canary check at +5m: apac 5xx = 5.9% (was 11.8%). No new pager alerts.

mike_sre: increasing canary to 25% now.

apac-eng: queue depth reduced ~40% on affected nodes. KV cache churn decreased after economy eviction.

irene_oncall: after ramp to 25% looks stable, we'll hand off to evening oncall at 3175001290. I'll post a concise summary for next oncall.

dana_prod: Notifying top 10 enterprise customers flagged in APAC with ETA and mitigation.

irene_oncall: HANDOFF SUMMARY -> incident: APAC generation 5xx spike due to economy-tier overload after config change; mitigation: disabled economy lane for APAC for affected model set, steered non-rt traffic to EU, applied temporary per-tenant economy caps, canary ramped and successful. Customer impact: transient errors and higher latency for some APAC non-SLA traffic; enterprise SLAs preserved. Next steps: monitor 1h, investigate quantization change interaction, plan permanent policy tweak. Handoff to: mike_sre (night).

mike_sre: taking handoff. I'll watch through the night and escalate to infra if recurrence.

incident-bot: Thread closed for handoff at 3175001290 by irene_oncall.
